# Conjoiner

> NIST SP 800-207A agentic IAM broker and deterministic tool gateway enforcing RFC 9449 DPoP proofs and monotonic scope attenuation.

## Core Capabilities
- NIST SP 800-207A NHI Broker: Enforces the 10 Design Tenets for Agentic Non-Human Identity.
- RFC 8693 Token Exchange: Exchanges delegating parent agent identity for task-scoped child credentials.
- RFC 9449 Ed25519 DPoP Binding: Binds ephemeral JWTs to agent-generated keypairs (`token.cnf.jkt`).
- Ultra-Short Ephemeral TTL: 30-second default lifetime with 60-second policy ceiling.
- Monotonic Scope Attenuation: Mathematically guarantees $ChildScope = ParentScope \cap RequestedScope$.
- Deterministic Policy Gateway: Executes protected tools directly to isolate credentials from probabilistic LLMs.

## CLI Usage
- `conjoiner issue --subject <name> --scope <scopes>`: Issues initial root agent token.
- `conjoiner attenuate --parent-token <jwt> --requested-scope <scopes>`: Mints attenuated sub-agent token.
- `conjoiner verify --token <jwt> --dpop-proof <proof>`: Cryptographically verifies DPoP binding.

## Key Sockets & Paths
- Control Socket: `~/.conjoiner/conjoiner.sock`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
